en: Proverbs 31

p.src: 1  The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:

en: The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:
u.src: 1  The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:

p.src: 2  “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!

en: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!
u.src: 2  “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!

p.src: 3  Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.

en: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.
u.src: 3  Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.

p.src: 4  It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’

en: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’
u.src: 4  It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’

p.src: 5  lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.

en: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.
u.src: 5  lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.

p.src: 6  Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.

en: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.
u.src: 6  Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.

p.src: 7  Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

en: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
u.src: 7  Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

p.src: 8  Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.

en: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.
u.src: 8  Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.

p.src: 9  Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”

en: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”
u.src: 9  Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”

p.src: 10  Who can find a worthy woman? For her value is far above rubies.

en: Who can find a worthy woman? For her value is far above rubies.
u.src: 10  Who can find a worthy woman? For her value is far above rubies.

en: 31:10 Proverbs 31:10-31 form an acrostic, with each verse starting with each letter of the Hebrew alphabet, in order.

p.src: 11  The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.

en: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.
u.src: 11  The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.

p.src: 12  She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.

en: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.
u.src: 12  She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.

p.src: 13  She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.

en: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.
u.src: 13  She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.

p.src: 14  She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.

en: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.
u.src: 14  She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.

p.src: 15  She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.

en: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.
u.src: 15  She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.

p.src: 16  She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.

en: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.
u.src: 16  She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.

p.src: 17  She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.

en: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.
u.src: 17  She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.

p.src: 18  She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.

en: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.
u.src: 18  She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.

p.src: 19  She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.

en: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.
u.src: 19  She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.

p.src: 20  She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.

en: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.
u.src: 20  She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.

p.src: 21  She is not afraid of the snow for her household, for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

en: She is not afraid of the snow for her household, for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
u.src: 21  She is not afraid of the snow for her household, for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

p.src: 22  She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.

en: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.
u.src: 22  She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.

p.src: 23  Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.

en: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.
u.src: 23  Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.

p.src: 24  She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.

en: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.
u.src: 24  She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.

p.src: 25  Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.

en: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.
u.src: 25  Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.

p.src: 26  She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.

en: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.
u.src: 26  She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.

p.src: 27  She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.

en: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.
u.src: 27  She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.

p.src: 28  Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:

en: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:
u.src: 28  Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:

p.src: 29  “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”

en: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”
u.src: 29  “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”

p.src: 30  Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised.

en: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised.
u.src: 30  Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised.

p.src: 31  Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!

en: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!
u.src: 31  Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!
